text:
- **CI run speed:** Each pull request now starts at most two macOS jobs, and a docs-only change skips the Go checks. The median run time is still above the target.
- **Sprint close rule:** A sprint now closes only on the coverage patterns it added or changed while open. Pending patterns from other sessions no longer block it.
- **Agent evaluation voting:** The vote now applies to passages. A passage fails only when a majority of its calls agree on a finding.
- **Design page review:** The pm-cli and sprint-lifecycle design pages were recorded as staying as they are.
